Name: Radio-Active
Author: BurninWeeknd
Description:
Adds a new radioactive tier to:
- [b]Radioactive Fishing rod[/b]: Features three attachment slots, faster bite time, and a bigger bar inside the fishing mini game. Buy it from Willy after unlocking the walnut room for 500,000 coins
- [b]Radioactive Scythe[/b]: Features a larger AOE, acts the same as iridium, easy grass chopping, crop harvesting. Buy it from Krobus after unlocking the walnut room for 500,000 coins (Features two custom enchants, see below) 
- [b]Radioactive Pickaxe[/b]: Able to 2 hit radioactive ore, upgrade your iridium Pickaxe at the blacksmith for 5 radioactive bars and 100,000 coins
- [b]Radioactive Axe[/b]: One chop trees and hardwood stumps, upgrade your iridium Axe at the blacksmith for 5 radioactive bars and 100,000 coins
- [b]Radioactive Hoe & Watering can[/b]: Features a base of 5x5 and reaching allows 7x7 for those who use upgraded iridium sprinklers. Upgrade your iridium Hoe & Watering can at the blacksmith for 5 radioactive bars and 100,000 coins
- [b]Radioactive Pan[/b]: Features a higher level for more rewards. 2 panning spots are randomly placed in the world space on day start when you have acquired radioactive pan, also adds radioactive ore to the loot pool of added panning spots. 

Adds two custom enchants to the radioactive scythe:
[b]Reaping[/b]: Allows the scythe to harvest machines 
[b]Overgrowth[/b]: Greatly increases range of scythe 
Thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Protatochip]Protatochip[/url] for the "Reaping" enchantment idea
